description: Typical real-world size of each object category as it appears on a kitchen, dining or desk table in a DROID scene: the LONGEST bounding-box dimension in metres, with the reason. The solver scales every asset uniformly to this size, so shapes are never distorted. A task may override it for one object (size_m + size_reason) when the instruction means a different variant, e.g. a toy pan.
